import asyncio

class ChatServer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.clients = []
        self.message_history = []

    def handle_client(self, client):
        self.clients.append(client)

        async def receive_message():
            while True:
                message = await client.read()
                if message is None:
                    break

                # Broadcast the message to all other connected clients
                for c in self.clients:
                    if c != client:
                        await c.write(message)

                # Log the incoming message
                self.message_history.append(message)

        async def disconnect_client():
            self.clients.remove(client)
            print(f""Client {client.peer} disconnected"")

        client.set_handler(""receive_message"", receive_message())
        client.set_handler(""disconnect"", disconnect_client())

    def run(self):
        reactor.listenTCP(1234, self)
        print(""Chat server running on port 1234"")
        reactor.run()

if __name__ == ""__main__"":
